complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Break down the Project Setup & Database Schema Implementation task into 8 detailed subtasks, each with clear acceptance criteria. Include specific subtasks for repository setup, environment configuration, database schema implementation for each entity, relationship implementation, Redis/Bull MQ setup, CI/CD configuration, migration system, and testing framework.
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: This task involves setting up the entire foundation of the project including repository structure, development environment, database schema with 7 entities and their relationships, caching system, message queue, CI/CD pipeline, and migrations. The complexity is high due to the need for careful planning of the database schema that will support all other components and the technical diversity of the setup requirements.

complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Break down the Authentication & Authorization System implementation into 9 detailed subtasks. Include specific subtasks for JWT implementation, refresh token mechanism, MFA setup, role-based access control, encryption systems (both at rest and in transit), field-level PII encryption, audit logging, compliance verification, and security testing.
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: This task has high complexity due to security implications and compliance requirements. It involves implementing multiple authentication mechanisms (JWT, refresh tokens, MFA), complex authorization with role-based access control, encryption at multiple levels, comprehensive audit logging, and ensuring compliance with multiple security standards (LGPD, SOC 2, ISO 27001). Each component requires careful implementation to avoid security vulnerabilities.

complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Break down the Laura 01A Agent Core Implementation into 10 detailed subtasks. Include specific subtasks for agent architecture design, message processing pipeline, user authorization validation, NLP-based material specification parser, unique ID generation system, supplier selection algorithm, follow-up scheduling system, logging infrastructure, error handling, and integration testing framework.
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: This task represents the core intelligence of the system with high complexity due to NLP capabilities, complex business logic for supplier selection, and integration with multiple other components. The agent needs to parse natural language input, validate users, generate IDs, select suppliers based on scoring algorithm, schedule follow-ups, and maintain comprehensive logging. The NLP component alone adds significant complexity, as does the need to integrate with the scoring system.

complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Break down the WhatsApp Business API Integration into 8 detailed subtasks. complexityAnalysis.reasoning: This task involves integrating with an external API (WhatsApp Business) which adds complexity due to potential rate limits, authentication requirements, and webhook handling. Error handling is critical as messaging is a core function of the system.

complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Break down the Supplier Scoring Algorithm Implementation into 8 detailed subtasks. complexityAnalysis.reasoning: This task involves implementing a complex multi-factor scoring algorithm with weighted components. Each component requires its own data collection and calculation logic. The system must track historical scores, categorize suppliers, trigger recalculations based on events, and provide visualizations. The algorithm is central to the system's supplier selection intelligence, making accuracy critical.
